situations.title: 대기 지연 불만 환자
situations.tagline: I've been sitting here for three hours — is anyone even working?
situations.brief: 지연 원인을 투명하게 설명하고 예상 시간을 제시해 불만을 완화하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm sorry for the long wait — let me explain what's happening.
Patients with life-threatening issues are seen first.
I'll check on your place in line and update you shortly.

situations.title: 목소리 높아지는 초기 신호
situations.tagline: Don't tell me to calm down!
situations.brief: 자세·거리·톤을 조절해 초기 격화 신호를 조기에 진정시키세요.
keyPhrases: You're right to be frustrated — I'm listening.
Let's talk this through, I've got time for you.
Tell me what would help right now.

situations.title: 공간·개인영역 확보
situations.tagline: Back off — you're too close to me.
situations.brief: 안전 거리와 출구를 확보하며 위협감을 주지 않는 위치를 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll give you some space — is this better?
You can move wherever feels comfortable to you.
I'm not here to crowd you, just to help.

situations.title: 요구 반복 환자 경청
situations.tagline: I keep telling you what I need and nobody listens!
situations.brief: 반복되는 요구 이면의 실제 니즈를 짚어 신뢰를 회복하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me make sure I understand what you really need.
I hear you've had to repeat yourself — that's frustrating.
Here's what I can do right now for you.

situations.title: 통증·불편 기인 초조
situations.tagline: It hurts so bad I can't sit still — do something!
situations.brief: 통증 등 기본 욕구를 우선 해결해 초조의 근본 원인을 완화하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's get your pain under control first.
On a scale of zero to ten, how bad is it right now?
I'm getting something for you right away.
goals: 통증·불편 등 기본 욕구를 우선 해결한다

situations.title: 알코올 취기 공격성
situations.tagline: You think you're better than me? Come here and say it!
situations.brief: 자극을 최소화하는 접근으로 취기 상태의 공격성을 낮추세요.
keyPhrases: Nobody's judging you here — I just want to help.
Let's keep it calm; I'm on your side.
How about we sit down and talk this out?

situations.title: 치매 초조 행동
situations.tagline: This isn't my home. I want to go, let me out!
situations.brief: 진정을 유도하고 가족을 활용해 치매 환자의 초조를 완화하세요.
keyPhrases: You're safe here, and I'm going to stay with you.
Your daughter is on her way to see you.
Let's look at these photos together for a moment.

situations.title: 마약 갈망·요구 환자
situations.tagline: I'm in real pain — just give me the good stuff, come on.
situations.brief: 공감을 유지하면서 명확한 한계를 설정하세요.
keyPhrases: I believe your pain is real, and I want to treat it safely.
I can't give you that, but here's what I can offer.
Let's focus on what will actually help you feel better.

situations.title: 대기실 다인 긴장 확산
situations.tagline: Everyone here is fed up — this whole place is a joke!
situations.brief: 격앙된 환자를 격리·중재해 대기실 전체의 긴장 확산을 막으세요.
keyPhrases: Let's step over here where we can talk privately.
I want to hear your concern one-on-one.
I'll address this, but let's keep it calm for everyone.

situations.title: 언어폭력 대상 직원 보호
situations.tagline: You're useless — all of you should be fired!
situations.brief: 존중의 경계를 설정하며 관계를 재구축하고 직원을 보호하세요.
keyPhrases: I want to help you, and I need us to speak respectfully.
I won't accept being spoken to that way, but I'm still here for you.
Let's reset and figure this out together.

situations.title: 문화·인종 관련 불신
situations.tagline: People like me never get treated right in places like this.
situations.brief: 방어성을 낮추고 신뢰를 형성하며 문화적 불신을 완화하세요.
keyPhrases: I hear you, and I want to make sure you're treated with respect here.
Your concern is valid, and I'll do my best for you.
Tell me what would help you feel more comfortable.

situations.title: 보호자발 공격성
situations.tagline: If anything happens to my son, you'll answer to me!
situations.brief: 위협적인 동반 가족의 공격성을 관리하며 아이 치료를 보호하세요.
keyPhrases: I can see how much you love your son — we want the same thing.
Let me tell you exactly what we're doing for him.
I need us to stay calm so I can care for him well.

situations.title: 정신질환+초조 복합
situations.tagline: Stop plotting against me — I know what you're all doing!
situations.brief: 편집 사고를 자극하지 않는 언어로 복합적 초조를 완화하세요.
keyPhrases: No one here is against you — I want to help you feel safe.
I'll keep everything out in the open so you can see.
You're in charge of what we talk about.

situations.title: 무기 소지 의심
situations.tagline: Don't come any closer. I'm warning you.
situations.brief: 보안·경찰 호출과 직원 대피를 조율하며 자극 없이 거리를 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm keeping my distance — I don't want anyone to get hurt.
Can you tell me what's making you feel unsafe right now?
Let's talk, and I'll listen to whatever you need to say.

situations.title: 신체 공격 임박 코드
situations.tagline: I'll take all of you down if you touch me!
situations.brief: 팀을 호출하고 억제 결정을 신속히 판단하며 마지막까지 언어적 진정을 시도하세요.
keyPhrases: I don't want to restrain you — help me keep this calm.
Tell me what you need and I'll try to make it happen.
We're going to keep everyone safe, including you.
goals: 팀 호출과 억제 결정을 신속히 판단한다

situations.title: 억제 후 후속 소통
situations.tagline: You tied me down like an animal. How could you?
situations.brief: 억제 이후 존엄을 회복하고 신뢰를 재구축하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm sorry that was scary — we only did it to keep you safe.
Let me explain what happened and answer your questions.
Now that things are calmer, how are you feeling?
goals: 억제 경험의 감정을 인정하고 존엄을 회복한다

situations.title: 흥분성 섬망(ExDS)
situations.tagline: So hot — get it off me! Get it off!
situations.brief: 대사 위기를 인지하고 응급 진정과 냉각을 동시에 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: You're overheating — we're going to cool you down fast.
Stay with me, we're getting you help right now.
I'm right here; we've got you.

situations.title: 집단 폭력·다중 위협
situations.tagline: This is between us and them — stay out of it!
situations.brief: 다중 위협 상황에서 우선순위를 정하고 분리·보안 개입을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: I need everyone to separate so no one gets hurt.
Let's take this one group at a time — you first.
Security is here to keep everyone safe, including you.

situations.title: 진정제 투여 후 감시
situations.tagline: I'm so tired... just let me sleep it off.
situations.brief: 진정제 투여 후 호흡·의식을 지속 재사정하며 안전을 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to keep checking on you while you rest.
Can you open your eyes for me for a second?
Take slow, deep breaths — I'm watching over you.
goals: 진정 후 호흡과 의식을 지속 재사정한다

situations.title: 자의 퇴원(AMA) 갈등 완화
situations.tagline: I'm done waiting. I'm leaving right now, get out of my way.
situations.brief: 자의 퇴원을 고집하는 환자의 분노를 낮추고 위험을 설명하며 선택지를 제시하세요.
keyPhrases: I hear that you're frustrated — help me understand what happened.
I can't hold you here, but I want you to know what the risks are.
If you decide to stay, I'll make the wait as short as I can.
goals: 환자의 불만을 경청하고 감정을 먼저 낮춘다
자의 퇴원의 위험을 비난 없이 설명하고 선택지를 제시한다
